name.en: Casa Norte SDS900-R 900-Watt SDS-Plus Rotary Hammer with Auxiliary Handle for Concrete
name.pt-BR: Martelete Perfurador Casa Norte SDS900-R 900 W SDS-Plus com Empunhadura Auxiliar para Concreto

description.en: A corded SDS-Plus rotary hammer for deep holes in concrete and masonry during heavier renovation work. Its long body and large auxiliary handle support controlled two-hand drilling with masonry bits.
description.pt-BR: Martelete perfurador com fio e encaixe SDS-Plus para furos profundos em concreto e alvenaria em reformas pesadas. O corpo longo e a empunhadura auxiliar ampla dão controle com as duas mãos.
